items.headline: Anthropic ka Nasdaq debut, valuation $2 trillion
items.detail: Anthropic ke share Nasdaq debut par $111.50 par khule — IPO price $83 se 34% upar; din bhar me company ki valuation $2 trillion tak pahunchi, AI company ka ab tak ka sabse bada IPO.
items.exam_angle: AI companies, IPO records — UPSC Economy

items.headline: Kerch Bridge par teesra hamla, Putin ne badle ki dhamki
items.detail: Ukraine ne chaar din me teesri baar Kerch Bridge par hamla kiya, rail seva ruk gayi; Putin ne bahut zyada dardnak jawab ki dhamki di aur samudri-urja yuddh-viram ki baat khatm kar di.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine war, Crimea — UPSC IR

items.headline: Berlin me Ukraine sahyogiyon ki badi baithak
items.detail: Zelenskyy Berlin pahunche; 40 se zyada sahyogi deshon ke neta Coalition of the Willing baithak me mile, shanti vartao me Europe ki bhumika aur suraksha guarantee par charcha hui.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine war, European security — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kushner: Russia ko NATO-jaisi guarantee manzoor
items.detail: America ke doot Jared Kushner ne Berlin me kaha ki Russia ko Ukraine ke liye NATO ke Article 5 jaisi suraksha guarantee manzoor hai aur Trump bhi iske liye taiyaar hain; Russia ne abhi is par kuch nahi kaha.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine war, NATO Article 5 — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump ne divangat Pete Rose ko maafi di
items.detail: Rashtrapati Trump ne baseball ke sabse zyada hit (4,256) banane wale divangat Pete Rose ko tax mamle me poori maafi de di; Rose ko 1990 me tax jhooth bolne par saza hui thi aur woh 2024 me guzar gaye the.

items.headline: China ko 9 lakh AI chip ki manzoori
items.detail: America ne December 2025 se May 2026 tak Nvidia aur AMD ke lagbhag 8,79,000 advanced AI chip China ko bechne ki manzoori di, jinme Alibaba ke 75,000 aur Tencent ke 1,50,000 chip shamil hain.
items.exam_angle: US-China tech war, export controls — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Gaza me Israel ka pehla zameeni hamla
items.detail: Yuddh-viram ke baad pehli baar Israel ne madhya Gaza me zameeni karvai ki, Yellow Line se aage Nuseirat ke paas ek surang ko nishana banaya; teen log mare gaye aur hazaaron phir se beghar hue, karvai 19 November ko poori hui.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Palestine, ceasefire — UPSC IR

items.headline: UN pramukh ki race atki, neta ka sankat
items.detail: Suraksha Parishad aath daur ke gupt matdan ke baad bhi Guterres ke uttaradhikari par sahmat nahi ho payi, aur 31 December ko unka karyakal khatm hone par UN bina pramukh ke reh sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: UN Secretary-General selection, UNSC — UPSC IR

items.headline: California ne Nvidia ko summon bheja
items.detail: California ke Attorney General Rob Bonta ne Nvidia ko subpoena bhejkar jaanch shuru ki ki kya uske advanced chip ya gopniya jankari China tak pahunchi aur kya company ne investors ko gumrah kiya; abhi koi aarop tay nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: US-China chip war, export controls — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Kyiv par Russia ka ballistic missile hamla
items.detail: Russia ne subah-saver Kyiv par ballistic missile se hamla kiya; Obolonskyi, Podilskyi aur Holosiivskyi jilon me aag lagi, imaratein aur ek infrastructure facility kshatigrast hui.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Macron: Ukraine ki NATO sadasyata par dobara bahas
items.detail: France ke rashtrapati Emmanuel Macron ne Berlin me kaha ki Russia ki maximalist maangon ko dekhte hue Ukraine ki NATO sadasyata par dobara bahas honi chahiye; koi samay-sima ghoshit nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: NATO expansion, Ukraine — UPSC IR

items.headline: Bukele teesri baar rashtrapati chunav ladenge
items.detail: El Salvador ke rashtrapati Nayib Bukele February 2027 ke chunav ke liye teesri baar ummeedvari darj karane wale hain; 2025 ke samvidhan sanshodhan se anishchit-kal punah chunav ki anumati mili hai.
items.exam_angle: El Salvador chunav, term limits — UPSC IR

items.headline: UK dega Ukraine ko 1,000 se zyada drones
items.detail: Britain ne Ukraine ke liye £260 million ka package ghoshit kiya, jisme 1,000 se zyada lambi doori wale strike drone hain jo 1,000 km se zyada ud sakte hain.
items.exam_angle: UK-Ukraine defence aid — UPSC IR

items.headline: US Senate ne Iran yuddh-prastav kharij kiya
items.detail: America ki Senate ne 51-48 se woh prastav kharij kar diya jo Rashtrapati Trump ko Iran yuddh khatm karne ya Congress ki manzoori lene ko kehta tha; teen Republican ne prastav ka saath diya tha.
items.exam_angle: US War Powers Resolution, Iran yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Europe Russia se baatchit ke liye taiyaar
items.detail: Berlin me Ukraine sahyogiyon ne kaha ki Europe Russia se baatchit ke liye taiyaar hai; Putin ne Europe ke netaon ko Moscow aane ka nyota diya, lekin Russia ne abhi Europe ki bhumika manzoor nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shanti varta, Coalition of the Willing — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump-Xi-Putin ki pehli tri-pakshiya shikhar baithak
items.detail: Shenzhen me America, China aur Russia ke netaon ne pehli baar teen-pakshiya shikhar baithak ki aur chaar-sutriya 'shanti ghoshna' jaari ki — UN sudhar, tel aapurti, ICC aur parmanu jokhim par samvaad; Ukraine ya Iran yuddh ka zikr nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: US-China-Russia trilateral, APEC — UPSC IR

items.headline: Denmark ne Greenland suraksha samjhauta manzoor kiya
items.detail: Denmark ki sansad ne 109-0 se America-Greenland suraksha samjhaute ko manzoori di; America Greenland me do naye sainya adde bana sakega aur Pituffik adde ka vistar karega.
items.exam_angle: Greenland, Arctic suraksha, NATO — UPSC IR

items.headline: ICJ: Myanmar ne Rohingya narsanhar kiya
items.detail: Antarrashtriya Nyayalaya ne 9-6 faisle me kaha ki Myanmar ki sena ne 2017 me Rohingya ke khilaf narsanhar kiya; lagbhag 10,000 log mare gaye aur saat lakh se zyada Bangladesh bhaage; muaavza baad me tay hoga.
items.exam_angle: ICJ, Genocide Convention, Rohingya — UPSC IR

items.headline: Russia ne Wikimedia ko undesirable ghoshit karne ki dhamki di
items.detail: Russia ke Prosecutor General ne Wikimedia Foundation ko chetavni di hai ki Wikipedia chalane wali sanstha ko undesirable ghoshit kiya ja sakta hai, kyunki us par desh ko asthir karne ka aarop hai.
items.exam_angle: Russia ka undesirable kanoon, Wikipedia — UPSC IR

items.headline: Houthi hamle me Riyadh ki sabse unchi imarat kshatigrast
items.detail: Yemen ke Houthi vidrohiyon ke hamle me Riyadh ki sabse unchi imarat, PIF Tower, ki kai manzilein kshatigrast hui; koi ghayal nahi hua, lekin aas-paas ki imaratein bhi nuksan me aayi.
items.exam_angle: Houthi-Saudi sangharsh, West Asia — UPSC IR

items.headline: UK me Pelicot-jaisi yaun hinsa par chaar doshi
items.detail: Britain ki Winchester adalat ne chaar aadmiyon ko doshi thahraya jinhone pati dwara nasha di gayi mahila ke saath yaun hinsa ki; mahila ne Pelicot ki tarah apni pehchan khud ujagar ki.
items.exam_angle: Pelicot mamla, UK kanoon — UPSC Society

items.headline: COP31 masaude se fossil fuel ka zikr gayab
items.detail: Antalya me COP31 ke naye masaude se jeevashm indhan se door hatne ka har zikr hata diya gaya; 1.5°C lakshya se aage badhne ki baat mani gayi aur bijli ki hissedari 35% tak badhane ka lakshya barkarar raha.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu vaarta — UPSC Environment

items.headline: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard ka data leak hua
items.detail: Teeno ne mana ki teesre-paksh wale vendor par hamle me grahakon ke naam aur email leak hue; card number surakshit rahe aur payment seva par koi asar nahi pada, ransomware group n0n ne zimmedari li.
items.exam_angle: Cyber suraksha, third-party risk — UPSC Economy

items.headline: Zelenskyy: Ab chaar-pakshiya vaarta, NATO-EU guarantee
items.detail: Berlin me Zelenskyy ne kaha ki Russia se agli vaarta chaar-pakshiya hogi — Ukraine, Europe, America aur Russia; NATO aur EU sadasyata ko sabse mazboot suraksha guarantee bataya.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shanti vaarta, NATO — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kyiv par Russia ka ballistic missile hamla
items.detail: Russia ne raat-bhar aur subah Kyiv aur pashchimi Ukraine par lagbhag 50 missilein daagin; Kyiv me teen log mare gaye, do ghayal hue aur teen pul kshatigrast hue, kai jilon me aag lagi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: EU par pehla AI-sahayata wala cyber hamla
items.detail: European Commission ne mana ki October me uske aantarik system par AI auzaron se hamla hua; 22 October ko pakda gaya, kuch sevaein abhi bhi band hain aur jaanch jaari hai, karmchariyon ke data leak ka koi saboot nahi mila.
items.exam_angle: Cyber suraksha, AI — UPSC Sci & Tech

items.headline: IEA: Hormuz sankat ne urja ki duniya badli
items.detail: IEA ki World Energy Outlook 2026 me kaha gaya ki Bharat aur Dakshin-Purvi Asia 2035 tak duniya ki urja maang me vriddhi ka 45 pratishat hissa denge; Hormuz se tel-gais ki aapoorti me 2.8 arab barrel ka nuksan hua.
items.exam_angle: Urja suraksha, IEA, Hormuz — UPSC Economy

items.headline: Saudi ne Houthi missile ko hawa me roka
items.detail: Saudi vayu raksha ne Yemen ke Houthi vidrohiyon ki ballistic missile ko dakshini kshetra ke upar rok kar nasht kar diya; Jazan, Abha aur Khamis Mushait ke paas drone bhi giraye gaye.
items.exam_angle: West Asia sangharsh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Bangladesh hinsa: PM ne Bharat par aarop lagaya
items.detail: Pradhan Mantri Tarique Rahman ne kaha seema ke us paar se Awami League hinsa bhadka rahi hai; shutdown me aagjani aur bomb visfot hue, Yunus ke paitrik ghar par hamla hua aur Dhaka me 107 log giraftar hue.
items.exam_angle: Bharat-Bangladesh sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kyiv par Russia ka ballistic missile hamla
items.detail: Russia ne raat-bhar Kyiv aur pashchimi Ukraine par lagbhag 50 missilein daagin; Kyiv me teen log mare gaye aur 15 ghayal hue, Lviv me do log mare gaye, teen pul kshatigrast hue aur kai jilon me bijli band hui. (Sudhar: ghayalon ki sankhya 2 se badhkar 15 hui aur Lviv ke do mrityu jode gaye.)
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Asia bazaar: 2020 ke baad sabse bura hafta
items.detail: MSCI Asia-Pacific index shukravar ko 3.2% gira aur hafte me 8.3% toota — March 2020 ke baad sabse bura hafta; Nikkei 4.1% aur KOSPI 4.4% gire, AI rally par bharosa kamzor pada.
items.exam_angle: Global markets, AI rally — UPSC Economy

items.headline: White House ne cyber chief ko hataya
items.detail: Rashtrapati Trump ke rashtriya cyber nideshak Sean Cairncross ko tech outages ke baad pad se hataya gaya; Pentagon ki Kirsten Davies ko acting cyber director banaya gaya.
items.exam_angle: US cyber policy, AI threats — UPSC IR/Sci & Tech

items.headline: Canada me Goldy Brar sabse wanted, $250,000 inam
items.detail: Canada ke BOLO programme ne Goldy Brar ko 25 most-wanted ki list me pehle number par rakha; Winnipeg me 2023 hatya par first-degree murder ka aarop hai aur giraftari ki jankari par 250,000 Canadian dollar ka inam hai.
items.exam_angle: India-Canada relations, organised crime — UPSC IR

items.headline: Malaysia me Bharatiyon ki visa-free entry band
items.detail: Malaysia ne 1 January 2027 se Bharatiya nagrikon ki visa-free entry khatm karne ka elan kiya; MyVISA portal par 1 December 2026 se aavedan hoga, 2023 se chali 30-din ki suvidha 31 December ko samapt hogi.
items.exam_angle: India-Malaysia relations, visa policy — UPSC IR

items.headline: UK-EU shikhar: Brexit ke baad doosri mulaqat
items.detail: Brussels me PM Andy Burnham, Ursula von der Leyen aur Antonio Costa mile; yuva mobility, khaadya-jaanch khatm aur emissions trading par samjhaute ki ummeed hai, lekin EU chhatron ki tuition fee par vivaad se sauda atka hua hai.
items.exam_angle: UK-EU sambandh, Brexit ke baad — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kyiv par Russia ka ballistic missile hamla
items.detail: Russia ne raat-bhar Kyiv aur pashchimi Ukraine par lagbhag 100 missilein aur 400 drone daage; aath log mare gaye aur 28 ghayal hue, Kyiv ke teen pul kshatigrast hue aur kai jilon me bijli band hui; ek missile ke Poland ki taraf jaane ki jaanch jaari hai. (Sudhar: missilein ~50 se badhkar ~100, mrityu 5 se badhkar 8, ghayal 15 se badhkar 28.)
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iraqi fauj Kataib Hezbollah ke gadh me
items.detail: Iraqi sarkari faujon ne shukravar ko Jurf al-Sakher me Kataib Hezbollah ke gadh me pravesh kiya, tel-taskari ke aarop par hue tanav ke baad hue samjhaute ke tahat, bina kisi sangharsh ke.
items.exam_angle: Iraq-Iran proxy sangharsh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Senegal tat par pravasi naav doobi, darjanon lapata
items.detail: Senegal ke Yenne tat ke paas budhvar subah Europe ja rahi pravasi naav palat gayi — kam se kam 50 log sawaar the, chaar shav mile aur darjanon lapata hain.
items.exam_angle: Antarrashtriya pravasan — UPSC IR

items.headline: US-Venezuela sainya samjhauta, 20 saal baad
items.detail: America ke raksha mantri Pete Hegseth ne Caracas me Venezuela ke antarim netritva ke saath sainya samjhauta kiya — sanyukt prashikshan aur khufiya jaankari sajha hogi, Maduro ko hatane ke 10 mahine baad.
items.exam_angle: US-Latin America sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump ne Iran hamle ka faisla taal diya
items.detail: Trump ne Reuters aur Axios se kaha Iran par dobara hamle ka faisla naye saal ke baad hoga — 'jaldi nahi hai'; Netanyahu turant bombing ke liye dabav bana rahe hain.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran yuddh aur West Asia ki sthiti — UPSC/PCS ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Europe me yuvaon ki badi hadtaal
items.detail: 25 se zyada deshon me hazaaron yuva sadkon par utre — mehengaai, awaas aur shiksha ke liye paise, hathiyaron par kharch band karne ki maang; Italy me aam hadtaal, Britain me 350 se zyada school-college band.
items.exam_angle: Europe me yuva andolan aur sainya kharch par bahas — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye.
